description: A cryptographically-valid request that has already been accepted within the timestamp window. The replay-detection cache (keyed on `(keyid, created, signature)` per §7) MUST reject the duplicate.
scenario: T = 0:      Verifier receives the request below for the first time. Signature is valid, timestamp is fresh, Content-Digest matches. Verifier accepts the request and records `(keyid, created, signature)` in its dedup cache.
T = 30s:    Verifier receives the IDENTICAL wire payload — same headers, same body. Signature still mathematically valid; timestamp still within the 300s window; Content-Digest still matches.
Expected:   Verifier rejects with -32001 because the tuple is in the cache (per §7).

expected_on_first_delivery.verifier_behavior: Accept the request, record (keyid, created, signature) in dedup cache.

expected_on_replay.verifier_behavior: Look up (keyid, created, signature) in dedup cache → present → reject with -32001. A conformant verifier MAY skip Ed25519 verification on a cache hit since the result would be the same as the first delivery.
